title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Prizm #20 Jaxson Hayes New Orleans Pelicans Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm Jaxson Hayes card is a great addition to any NBA fan's collection. The card features the young athlete in his New Orleans Pelicans uniform, with a Pink Prizm background that really makes the card stand out. The card is part of the 2020-21 Panini Prizm set and has the card number No. 20.

This sports trading card from Panini has a lot of great features, including its unique Pink Prizm parallel/variety. While this card is not autographed, it is still a great find for any collector. Whether you're a fan of Jaxson Hayes, the New Orleans Pelicans, or just love basketball, this card is a must-have.
